entities.summary: William Sterling Cole was an American politician, lawyer, and civil servant who served as the first director general of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) from 1957 to 1961. Before his appointment to the IAEA he was a Republican member of the United States House of Representatives from New York.
